entities.name: Kami attacking during the Kami War

claims.subject: kamigawa
claims.source_excerpt: two symbiotic worlds: the utsushiyo, or material realm, and the kakuriyo, or kami spirit realm
claims.summary: Kamigawa is described as two interacting realms: material utsushiyo and spirit kakuriyo.
claims.limitation: The undated profile is a broad structural description, not a complete cosmology.

claims.subject: kamigawa
claims.source_excerpt: The Kami War had begun. Over the next twenty years

evidence.quote: The Kami War had begun. Over the next twenty years, spirits of every shape and size would descend on the plains

claims.summary: The kami attack on Reito marked the beginning of the Kami War, and the profile specifies twenty subsequent years of devastation.
claims.limitation: Twenty years is a span in the narrated conflict, not an AR year or an independently verified total war duration.

claims.subject: reito
claims.source_excerpt: the kami set upon the town of Reito
claims.summary: The attack by kami on Reito was a devastating early event in the Kami War.
claims.limitation: The general plane profile does not enumerate every attacker or survivor.

claims.subject: takeshi_konda
claims.source_excerpt: 1,200 years ago, Konda, Lord of Eiganjo, captured and imprisoned a part of O-Kagachi

evidence.quote: 1,200 years ago, Konda, Lord of Eiganjo, captured and imprisoned a part of O-Kagachi, the mightiest kami of Kamigawa.

claims.summary: Konda imprisoned part of O-Kagachi about 1,200 years before the Neon Dynasty guide's narrated present.
claims.limitation: The relative 1,200-year date belongs to the 2022 story's narrative frame; it is not an AR calendar conversion.

claims.subject: kamigawa_fragment_o_kagachi
claims.source_excerpt: broke free and became a new kami named Kyodai
claims.summary: The fragment of O-Kagachi that escaped imprisonment became Kyodai.
claims.limitation: This does not assert that Kyodai is identical to O-Kagachi in every respect.

claims.subject: kyodai
claims.source_excerpt: Kyodai partnered with Konda's daughter, Michiko, to defeat both O-Kagachi and Konda
claims.summary: Kyodai and Michiko together defeated O-Kagachi and Konda.
claims.limitation: The quoted overview does not establish the detailed order or tactics of the two defeats.

claims.subject: kamigawa
claims.source_excerpt: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down
claims.summary: O-Kagachi's death broke the boundary between Kamigawa's mortal and spirit realms, beginning their merger.
claims.limitation: The source does not say the two realms were already fully merged at Neon Dynasty's time.

claims.subject: kamigawa
claims.summary: Sites of merging between Kamigawa's two realms appeared unpredictably in the Neon Dynasty guide.
claims.limitation: A 2022 story-period description; no claims about the state of all sites in later continuity.

claims.subject: kamigawa_imperials
claims.source_excerpt: founded to help Kyodai manage the merging of the mortal and spirit realms
claims.summary: The Imperials originated to assist Kyodai with problems arising from the realms' merger.
claims.limitation: This explains the founding purpose, not the entire institution's later political history.

claims.subject: kamigawa
claims.source_excerpt: Over time, they expanded into government and rulership
claims.summary: The Kamigawan Imperial organization developed from merge management into government and rulership.
claims.limitation: The political description belongs to the Neon Dynasty period; it is not a verified current government as of 2026.

claims.subject: emperor_of_kamigawa
claims.source_excerpt: given to whomever Kyodai has chosen to bond with
claims.summary: In the Neon Dynasty Imperial system, Kyodai's bond determined who bore the title Emperor of Kamigawa.
claims.limitation: This is a rule of the 2022-described institution, not a list of every emperor.

claims.subject: saiba_futurists
claims.source_excerpt: they often dabble on the edges of the law
claims.summary: The Futurists pursued forbidden or borderline technologies despite Imperial rules on development.
claims.limitation: The guide does not establish that every Futurist broke the law or that later restrictions stayed unchanged.

remaining: The two Wizards profiles provide partial history, not a full Kamigawa chronology or exhaustive character index.
The 1,200-year reference is relative to the Neon Dynasty guide's narrative present and never mapped to AR.
Keep this research separate from deck creation, owner approvals and the protected Grixis encyclopedia.
